description: Novation Nocturn control numbers. This is the source-of-truth table shared by the nuts driver (src/Nuts.Driver/appsettings.json, section Midi:Mapping) and the Reason Remote codec (remote/Codecs/Lua Codecs/Nuts/Nocturn.lua, lookup tables at the top). Change all three together.

dials.description: Endless encoders. Relative, two's complement: 1-63 = clockwise, 65-127 = counter-clockwise.
dials.touchValues: 127 = touched, 0 = released. Reserved for soft takeover.

switches.description: The 16 buttons, modelled as switches, on CCs (not notes) in both directions: a CC carries an absolute value and keeps the whole note range on the loopback free for a keyboard. The hardware addresses these buttons and their LEDs by note number 0-15 on its USB wire; the driver re-publishes them as the CCs below and translates the LED CCs back. Each group has a kind (see docs/midi-mapping.md): "momentary" = press sends 127, release sends 0, the DAW owns the state and the LED; "toggle" = the driver keeps a latch, a press flips it, lights the LED and sends the new state (127 = on, 0 = off), a release is silent, and DAW feedback overwrites the latch. Measured on Reason 10 (2026-10-19): a codec "button" item acts on the press edge only and ignores a value 0, so a latching switch on a button item would toggle only every second press. The page row's codec items are therefore input="value" (absolute 0-127): Reason sets the Toggle remotables (Mute, Solo, EQ On, ...) from the value, which is what makes toggle work end to end. Page row = toggle + value items; PermaBar = momentary + button items.

pageRow.description: 8 switches above the dials, green LEDs. Indices 0-7. Kind: toggle, and the codec declares them as value items (input="value", min=0, max=127).

permaBar.description: 8 switches along the bottom, red LEDs. Indices 8-15 in surface order. Kind: momentary (only Page -/+ are mapped for the channel window; both are triggers and stay button items).

speedDial.description: Relative, same encoding as the dials. The click is the only press on the speed dial.
speedDial.clickKind: momentary - a click, not a switch

crossfader.description: 14-bit absolute pair [MSB, LSB]. The codec uses the MSB only (128 positions).

feedbackToSurface.description: DAW -> surface. Knob ring values are 0-11 segments (the driver clamps anything higher); ring modes are 0-5; switch LEDs are on/off on the same CCs as the switches (0 = off, > 0 = on), which the driver turns into the hardware's note LED addresses.
feedbackToSurface.switchLeds: same CCs as the switch table above (102-117)

ringModes.description: Firmware-defined ring display modes used by gRingModes in Nocturn.lua, matching the channel-strip layout in Nocturn.remotemap.
ringModes.0: fill from minimum - used by Level and the FX send levels
ringModes.3: centre, both directions - used by Pan and the EQ gains
